cases.name: test-parse-redirection-operators-normal-output
cases.description: Verifies correct extraction of standard output redirection operators and file targets from a standard token list.
cases.expected_behavior: Identifies the output redirection symbol and returns the correct target filename alongside remaining command arguments.

cases.name: test-parse-redirection-operators-edge-missing-target
cases.description: Verifies parser resilience when a redirection symbol appears at the very end of input without a following target.
cases.expected_behavior: Correctly flags an error or indicates a missing file target instead of panicking or crashing.

cases.name: test-parse-redirection-operators-oracle-dynamic
cases.description: Performs randomized check on token separation involving input and output redirection symbols.
cases.expected_behavior: Accurately extracts redirection operators and respective targets across various input positions.
